/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/types.d.ts; printf '\\n--- item types ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenuItem.d.ts; printf '\\n--- usage docs if local ---\\n'; rg -n \"DropdownMenu.Item|renderSwitcher|action\\(\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -g '*.md' | head -40"
